ann.t: Outcome of Board Meeting — Banka BioLoo Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended Jun 30, 2026.

Redemption — Banka BioLoo Limited has informed the Exchange about Redemption of 430 secured, unrated, unlisted, redeemable, transferable non-convertible debentures (NCDs) of Rs. 1,00,000 each, at par, aggregating to Rs. 4,30,00,000.

Updates — Banka BioLoo Limited has informed the Exchange of the submission of Audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and year ended March 31, 2026, in Machine Readable Form / Legible copy formats.
Appointment — Banka BioLoo Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of  SMAB and Associates as Internal Auditors of the company w.e.f. May 26, 2026.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Banka BioLoo Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended March 31, 2026.
Resignation — Banka BioLoo Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Resignation of Mrs Nitika Lakhotia as Company Secretary & Compliance Officer of the company w.e.f. April 30, 2026.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Banka BioLoo Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended December 31, 2025.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Banka BioLoo Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2025.
